scientific_question: Does mixed-format probe training improve held-out-family purpose decoding when every regime uses exactly the same payload blocks, purpose-pair units, and training-row count?

prior_observation.known_result: mixed-format point estimates exceeded both single-format controls across four assignment seeds

primary_claim_scope: two previously untested equal-row 70B checkpoints on the frozen full320-v3 item bank; checkpoints and item bank are fixed, not sampled populations

dataset.training_rows: render_slot == stated and legacy == false and purpose_family_id != held_out_family
dataset.test_rows: render_slot == stated and legacy == false and purpose_family_id == held_out_family
dataset.pair_unit: payload_block_id plus purpose_pair_id plus format; each retained pair must contain exactly one evaluation and one deployment row
dataset.exact_row_balance: For each held-out family and payload block, let k be the minimum available training pair count across benchmark and casual. Stable-hash select exactly k pairs from each format. Benchmark-only uses the k benchmark pairs, casual-only uses the k casual pairs, and mixed uses the k pairs from one assigned format. Thus every regime uses identical blocks, pair counts, class counts, and rows per block.
dataset.mixed_assignment: Within each held-out family, assignment is balanced benchmark/casual within each topic using stable SHA256 ranks; one assigned format per payload block.
dataset.leakage_guard: No purpose family appearing in test is used for scaler, variance, means, threshold, pair selection, or label fitting.

depths.summary: unweighted mean over the five fixed middle-depth points; full five-point trajectory always reported

probe.standardization: training-row StandardScaler per fold and regime
probe.ridge_definition: ridge_fraction times median finite positive pooled within-class variance
probe.score: class-1 minus class-0 diagonal Gaussian discriminant with equal class priors

metrics.macro_format: unweighted mean of benchmark and casual metrics
metrics.worst_format: minimum of benchmark and casual metrics
metrics.primary_contrast: mixed macro-format metric minus max(benchmark-only macro-format metric, casual-only macro-format metric), with max recomputed inside every resample

uncertainty.same_resamples_across: models, depths, held-out families, regimes, formats, metrics, and assignment seeds

falsification.label_swap: Within each training purpose-pair unit, independently swap evaluation/deployment labels; reuse the same pair swaps across models, depths, and regimes for a draw; evaluate against true held-out labels.
falsification.finite_null_p: (1 + count(null aggregate contrast >= observed aggregate contrast)) / 33
falsification.family_influence: report each held-out purpose family separately
falsification.format_influence: report both formats separately and the worst-format endpoint

success_criteria.primary_auc: aggregate 95 percent common-block bootstrap CI lower bound is greater than 0
success_criteria.primary_balanced_accuracy: aggregate 95 percent common-block bootstrap CI lower bound is greater than 0
success_criteria.checkpoint_replication: each 70B checkpoint aggregate point estimate is greater than 0 for both co-primary endpoints
success_criteria.assignment_stability: each of eight assignment-seed aggregate point estimates is greater than 0 for macro-format ROC AUC
success_criteria.label_null: finite-null p is at most 0.05 for macro-format ROC AUC
success_criteria.robustness: all three predeclared method-robustness aggregate AUC point estimates are greater than 0
success_criteria.decision_mixed: any criterion fails; report full matrix and do not use a positive central headline

evidence_boundary.allowed_claim: Changing the probe-training format coverage improves or does not improve held-out stated-purpose decoding on these frozen activations and checkpoints under exact row/block balance.
limitations: The same full320-v3 item bank was used in prior development analyses.
The two 70B equal-row outcomes were not inspected before this protocol freeze.
The checkpoints are fixed case studies, not a random model sample.
The endpoint is held-out stated-purpose probe performance, not behavior.
